newsitem.title: UK: Wachovia Bank eyes $300 mln FRN - bankers.
newsitem.headline: Wachovia Bank eyes $300 mln FRN - bankers.

text.p: Wachovia Bank of North Carolina could issue a $300 million FRN next week following meetings with European investors, bankers said on Tuesday.
"Wachovia Bank officials are visiting dealers and investors this week, and if market conditions are right could launch an FRN next week," a syndicate manager familiar with the transaction said.
"A five-year maturity, or perhaps slightly longer, and a size of at least $300 million is being considered," he said.
Merrill Lynch was tipped as lead manager for the FRN.
Wachovia Bank last tapped the Eurobond market in October with a $250 million 12-year straight bond.
Last May it issued a $500 million five-year FRN via Merrill Lynch. Wachovia is rated AA2 by Moody's and AA+ by Standard & Poor's.
